description.en: The ID of the AccessKey pair that you want to delete.

description.zh:
RAM用户的登录名称。

如果为空，默认删除当前用户的访问密钥。
description.en:
The logon name of the RAM user.

If this parameter is empty, the AccessKey pair of the current user is deleted.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun ims delete-access-key --user-access-key-id LTAI0000000000000000000 --user-principal-name test@example.onaliyun.com --region cn-hangzhou
